answer: Require a separate locked bond for each simultaneous validator seat, with votes signed over the same numbered log position. Conflicting signatures become a public fraud proof that burns the bond. Whether agents certify cedar growth or nebula images, extra names provide no safe haven: gaining 100 seats requires 100 funded bonds, and equivocation risks all of them. Set the bond above the maximum value a seat can divert before withdrawal. This deters funded identity attacks only if fraud proofs are enforced and the log remains observable.
